claim.supported_scope: One two-way interaction on an existing substantive path in a recursive PLS model, using standardized path- or factor-weighted stage-one scores, a generated product-score construct, simple slopes at moderator scores -1, 0, and +1, and matching bootstrap or Freedman-Lane product-path inference.
claim.estimand: The generated product-construct path coefficient and the conditional predictor-to-outcome slope beta_x + beta_xw * w at the three frozen standardized moderator levels.
assumptions: Exactly one declared two-stage product-score interaction is evaluated in the bounded workflow.
Stage one and stage two use the same model-wide complete-case observations and standardized construct-score convention.
The predictor and moderator main-effect paths required for hierarchical interpretation are present.
exclusions: Multiple simultaneous interactions, three-way interactions, categorical latent moderation, multigroup moderation, and higher-order moderation are excluded.
PCA weighting, case weights, generated higher-order constructs, and nonstandardized preprocessing are excluded.
Arbitrary probing values, Johnson-Neyman regions, and claims covering the full PROCESS catalogue are excluded.
warnings: The interaction coefficient is conditional on the fixed two-stage score construction and documented PLS settings.
Publication inference requires a matching qualified bootstrap or permutation artifact; point estimates alone are descriptive.

references.citation: Henseler and Chin (2010), A Comparison of Approaches for the Analysis of Interaction Effects Between Latent Variables Using Partial Least Squares Path Modeling, Structural Equation Modeling 17(1), 82-109
Independent standardized OLS implementation of the bounded two-stage product-score fixture
Independent development-only R base-lm moderation fixture

simulations.design: Signal interactions across bounded loadings, main effects, interaction magnitudes, sample sizes, and predictor-moderator correlations using the supported single-interaction recipe.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen scenario-indexed data and resampling streams invariant to worker count and execution order.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Every interaction estimate must match the independent standardized OLS reference within 1e-6, and preregistered signal-detection and interval-coverage bounds must pass.

simulations.design: Null-interaction models with nonzero main effects over the same supported model and distribution envelope.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen scenario-indexed null datasets and indexed permutation streams with all failures retained.
simulations.acceptance_rule: The preregistered Type-I-error confidence interval must contain the nominal level and no failed run may be silently removed.

boundaries.case: The predictor, moderator, outcome, or generated product has zero variance or creates a singular stage-two equation.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Execution fails with a method-specific diagnostic and emits no completed moderation result.

boundaries.case: The recipe requests multiple interactions, PCA weighting, case weights, higher-order constructs, or an invalid main-effect hierarchy.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The setup is blocked before execution and names the unsupported combination.

boundaries.case: Observed indicators are positively affine transformed or rows and constructs are consistently reordered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped interaction and simple-slope estimates remain equal within the frozen tolerance.

boundaries.case: The same inferential recipe is run with repeated execution and different supported worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Resample identities, estimates, intervals, probabilities, and ordering are exactly equal.

boundaries.case: The interaction mapping, generated product, coefficient, probe level, inference identity, or method version is altered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict project validation rejects the archive rather than displaying the changed moderation result.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a result whose moderation capability identity differs from its recipe.
Reject a moderation payload relabeled with another method version.
Reject a moderation result whose dataset fingerprint no longer matches.
Reject any modified archive member whose checksum differs.
Reject duplicate keys, unknown fields, non-finite coefficients, invalid probe levels, or inconsistent inference identities.
Never reinterpret interaction placeholders or preview product paths as current bounded moderation evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: Only a typed single-interaction recipe and pls_two_stage_moderation_v1 nested result may satisfy current evidence.

native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For the same typed interaction recipe, dataset fingerprint, seed, worker-invariant stream plan, and method versions, GUI and CLI analytical payloads must be exactly equal apart from operational identifiers and timestamps.
accessibility_rules: Interaction, simple-slope, and inference values are available in accessible tables.
Setup failures and uncertainty warnings are associated with their controls and do not rely on color or diagram position.
